author: Fallon Fischer
title: Human remains found between two walls in Ruidoso Downs identified - NewsBreak
text:
By Fallon Fischer No media credit provided. ,
9 hours ago
RUIDOSO DOWNS, N.M. (KRQE) – Mummified human remains that were found between two walls inside a building in Ruidoso Downs have been identified, the Lincoln County Sheriff’s Office announced Wednesday.
The remains were discovered on June 21, 2023, inside a building on the 26000 block of Highway 70 by construction workers , according to Sheriff Michael Wood.
Asbestos found inside Lindy’s Diner building after part of wall collapsed With the help of DNA testing and genealogy, investigators were able to track down a relative of the victim who confirmed they had a family member who had been missing for years.
The unidentified remains were confirmed through dental records obtained by the Office of the Medical Investigator as belonging to 50-year-old Freddy Ray Baca from Ruidoso.
Investigators learned that Baca was last seen by family in 2018; however, he was not reported missing.
The case remains under investigation by the 12th Judicial Major Crimes Unit, comprised of Investigators from the 12th Judicial District Attorney’s Office, Alamogordo Police Department, Lincoln County Sheriff’s Office, Otero County Sheriff’s Office, and the Ruidoso Police Department.
Anyone with information related to the death of Baca is asked to contact the Lincoln County Sheriff’s Office, Criminal Investigations Division, 575-648-2341.
